extracted.name: VashBake Pancake
extracted.description: VashBake Pancake is a fluffy battered cake cooked on a griddle or flat top surface. VashBake Pancake is a breakfast or dinner sometimes dessert with dulce fillings like berries and cinnamon. VashBake Pancake is always a favorite.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 teaspoon salt, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Make a well, then add the wet ingredients. Stir to combine.
Scoop the batter onto a hot griddle or pan.
Cook for two to three minutes, then flip.
Cook until brown on both sides
